# Diagnostics

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Reflash the transmission computer and verify the car recognizes the transfer case connection. [t1044]

[Partial] Locate the OBD connector and connect a code reader to it. [t1278]

[Partial] Obtain remotes, lock doors with power switch, cycle ignition over six times in ten seconds to program transmitters. [t2142]

[Partial] Inspect the rear differential housing for existing holes and evaluate drilling if they are missing. [t1131]

[Partial] Lift front, loosen and remove both pinch bolts securing the steering shaft lower joint. [t1495]

[Partial] Lift the front to remove weight, then loosen and remove both pinch bolts securing the steering shaft lower joint. [t1495]

[Partial] Install the new LED headlight bulbs into the existing OEM wire harness, then verify that the turn signal fuse is intact. [t1611]

[Partial] Locate the electronic flasher unit and remove any existing load-based or inline fuse holder. [t2114]

[Partial] Check the cruise control module connector on the passenger side inner fender near the firewall. [t1295]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Obtain all remote transmitters you wish to program.
2. [Partial] Close every door and lock them using the power lock switch on the driver's side door.
3. Insert a key into the ignition and remove it more than 6 times within 10 seconds.
4. Watch for indicators flashing twice, which signals programming mode is active.
5. [Partial] Turn the key to the ACC position (or as far as possible without starting).
6. Press any button on the first remote transmitter you want programmed.
7. [Partial] Confirm that indicators flash twice again to verify correct programming.
8. [Partial] Unlock and lock the vehicle using the driver's door switch once more.
9. Press a button on the second remote transmitter to be added.
10. [Partial] Repeat steps 8-9 for any remaining transmitters in your set.
11. Open the driver's side door to exit the programming mode completely.
12. Test every programmed remote to ensure they function correctly.

_Procedure reported by [t2142]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1295] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Check the cruise control module connector located on the passenger side inner fender near the firewall.
2. [Partial] Unplug the connector from the module.
3. Blow air into both the plug and socket to remove any moisture or debris.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1044] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Reflash the transmission computer (TCM or PCM) to prevent limp mode in four-wheel low.
2. Verify that the car recognizes the transfer case is connected to the driveline.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1278] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Locate the OBD connector on the vehicle.
2. Connect a code reader to the OBD port.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1131] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Inspect the rear differential housing for existing holes intended to mount outer ABS sensors.
2. [Partial] If sensor mounting points are missing, evaluate if drilling new holes is worth the effort.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1495] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Lift the front of the vehicle to remove weight from the suspension.
2. Loosen and remove both pinch bolts securing the steering shaft lower joint.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1611] [Partial]</summary>

1. Install the new LED headlight bulbs into the existing OEM wire harness.
2. Verify that the turn signal fuse is intact and functioning.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t2114] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Locate the electronic flasher unit under the dash.
2. Remove the existing load-based or inline fuse holder if present.

</details>

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Note that the oldest remote code is erased each time a new one is added. [t2142]
- The key must stay inserted and removed quickly (over 6 times) within a 10-second window. [t2142]
- Note that the input shaft has a flat notch where the mounting bolt faces. [t1495]
- Observe that the other end of the steering shaft also features spines with a matching notch. [t1495]
- Distinguish between a connector that looks tight and one that is actually loose. [t1295]
- Note: The module location differs from the throttle cable actuator, which sits under the hood near the wiper motor. [t1295]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Failing to align the spline pinch bolts vertically when wheels are straight [t1495]
